WITH s0 AS ( SELECT * FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND business_unit='CFS' ), s1 AS ( SELECT * FROM s0 WHERE is_latest_version=1 AND lower(subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ), s2 AS ( SELECT d.trade_id,d.tenant_id,d.business_unit, s.derivative_type, CASE WHEN upper(trim(d.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(s.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc' THEN 'SIP' ELSE left(d.contract_number,3) END AS client_code FROM s1 d LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND s.business_unit=d.business_unit AND s.security_id=d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit=d.business_unit AND p.trade_id=d.trade_id WHERE d.transaction_date < :valueDate AND ( (lower(s.derivative_type)='future' AND ( (p.is_premium_paid=1 AND p.transaction_date=:cob) OR (s.maturity_date=:cob AND (p.is_premium_paid=0 OR p.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(d.netting_status)='not_netted') OR (lower(d.netting_status)='fully_netted' AND d.netting_date=:valueDate))) OR (lower(s.derivative_type) NOT IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put','future') AND ( (p.is_premium_paid=1 AND p.transaction_date=:cob) OR (s.maturity_date=:cob AND (p.is_premium_paid=0 OR p.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(d.netting_status) IN ('not_netted','partially_netted')) OR (lower(d.netting_status) IN ('fully_netted','partially_netted') AND d.netting_date=:valueDate))) OR lower(s.derivative_type) IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put')) ), s3 AS ( SELECT x.* FROM s2 x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera_backup_04_10.deal_active_lots_table a WHERE a.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND a.business_unit=x.business_unit AND a.trade_id=x.trade_id AND a.value_date<=:valueDate) ), s4 AS ( SELECT x.* FROM s3 x JOIN opera_backup_04_10.financial_year_table y ON y.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND y.start_date<=:cob AND y.end_date>=:cob JOIN opera_backup_04_10.premium_fy_table p ON p.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND p.business_unit=x.business_unit AND p.trade_id=x.trade_id AND p.financial_year=y.financial_year LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.fixing_table f ON f.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND f.business_unit=x.business_unit AND f.trade_id=x.trade_id ), events AS ( SELECT 'S0-scoped-clone' AS stage,trade_id FROM s0 UNION ALL SELECT 'S1-bu-rules',trade_id FROM s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'S2-cash-events',trade_id FROM s2 UNION ALL SELECT 'S3-has-lots',trade_id FROM s3 UNION ALL SELECT 'S4-has-fy-premium',trade_id FROM s4 UNION ALL SELECT 'S8-valid-client',trade_id FROM s4 WHERE client_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(client_code)<>'' AND lower(trim(client_code))<>'null' ) SELECT stage,trade_id,count(*) AS n_rows FROM events GROUP BY stage,trade_id

WITH s0 AS ( SELECT * FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND business_unit='CFS' ), s1 AS ( SELECT * FROM s0 WHERE is_latest_version=1 AND lower(subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ), s2 AS ( SELECT d.trade_id,d.tenant_id,d.business_unit, s.derivative_type, CASE WHEN upper(trim(d.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(s.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc' THEN 'SIP' ELSE left(d.contract_number,3) END AS client_code FROM s1 d LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND s.business_unit=d.business_unit AND s.security_id=d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit=d.business_unit AND p.trade_id=d.trade_id WHERE d.transaction_date < :valueDate AND ( (lower(s.derivative_type)='future' AND ( (p.is_premium_paid=1 AND p.transaction_date=:cob) OR (s.maturity_date=:cob AND (p.is_premium_paid=0 OR p.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(d.netting_status)='not_netted') OR (lower(d.netting_status)='fully_netted' AND d.netting_date=:valueDate))) OR (lower(s.derivative_type) NOT IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put','future') AND ( (p.is_premium_paid=1 AND p.transaction_date=:cob) OR (s.maturity_date=:cob AND (p.is_premium_paid=0 OR p.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(d.netting_status) IN ('not_netted','partially_netted')) OR (lower(d.netting_status) IN ('fully_netted','partially_netted') AND d.netting_date=:valueDate))) OR lower(s.derivative_type) IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put')) ), s3 AS ( SELECT x.* FROM s2 x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a WHERE a.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND a.business_unit=x.business_unit AND a.trade_id=x.trade_id AND a.value_date<=:valueDate) ), s4 AS ( SELECT x.* FROM s3 x JOIN opera.financial_year_table y ON y.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND y.start_date<=:cob AND y.end_date>=:cob JOIN opera.premium_fy_table p ON p.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND p.business_unit=x.business_unit AND p.trade_id=x.trade_id AND p.financial_year=y.financial_year LEFT JOIN opera.fixing_table f ON f.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND f.business_unit=x.business_unit AND f.trade_id=x.trade_id ), events AS ( SELECT 'S0-scoped-clone' AS stage,trade_id FROM s0 UNION ALL SELECT 'S1-bu-rules',trade_id FROM s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'S2-cash-events',trade_id FROM s2 UNION ALL SELECT 'S3-has-lots',trade_id FROM s3 UNION ALL SELECT 'S4-has-fy-premium',trade_id FROM s4 UNION ALL SELECT 'S8-valid-client',trade_id FROM s4 WHERE client_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(client_code)<>'' AND lower(trim(client_code))<>'null' ) SELECT stage,trade_id,count(*) AS n_rows FROM events GROUP BY stage,trade_id
